bullets.text: PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss accused a senior Tamil Nadu official of direct involvement in the Pallikaranai wetland scam, and the office should monitor developments closely.
Public near Periyapalayam blocked the Chennai-Tirupati road for thirty minutes protesting a five-hour power cut, and the office should watch local electricity supply stability.
Heavy rain warnings prompted holiday announcements for schools in Chennai and Thiruvallur due to Cyclone Murasu, and the office should coordinate precautionary measures.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss questioned Chief Minister Vijay carrying evidence regarding the Pallikaranai wetland issue, and the office should track official responses.
Severe traffic congestion was reported on the Velachery 100 Feet Road, and the office should coordinate with traffic authorities to ease commuters' travel.
A person searched for a lost cellphone in waterlogged conditions on the Ambattur-Ayapakkam road, and the district team should address drainage infrastructure.
Fire departments in Tiruttani and Gummidipoondi conducted fire safety demonstrations for students ahead of Diwali, and the team should review safety compliance.
Loan sanction orders worth one hundred thirty-nine crore rupees were distributed to nine hundred one women self-help groups, and the district team should monitor disbursement.
Tamil Nadu partnered with IIT Madras to launch an AI data center through a formal memorandum of understanding, and the portfolio team should track implementation progress.
Vultr launched a twenty megawatt artificial intelligence supercluster in Chennai, boosting the state's digital infrastructure, and the office should support further tech investments.
CERT-In issued a critical alert regarding Crafty Falcon AI-driven cyberattacks targeting financial institutions, and the portfolio team should coordinate cybersecurity defenses.
L. Murugan responded to queries regarding whether opposition parties are negotiating with TVK MLAs, and the office should monitor political developments.
The Kerala Law Academy invited academic papers for its seminar on good governance and artificial intelligence, and the department should note this event.
